ACTUAL IID JOINT CONVERSE BY EXACT SOURCE-SECTOR LOCALIZATION
2026-10-08 | /root/sol_collision_precision

STATUS

INTERNALLY-PROVED-CANDIDATE. This is the shortest current proof of the
actual positive-critical-splitting qutrit quantum-branch law. It keeps the
FULL exact Schur experiment. There is no probability-tail conditioning,
largest-likelihood coefficient, far-spin transport estimate or unequal-spin
symbol in this proof. INPUT Schur pinching and selected source right moduli
make these unnecessary. The strongest BOUNDED_SLD_SCORE handles arbitrary
noncommuting outputs, so no covariance/output pinching is required. The
earlier centrally symmetrized version is preserved separately as
IID_PINCHED_JOINT_CENTRAL_CONTROL.txt. The earlier correct proofs
IID_JOINT_FLAG_CONVERSE.txt and IID_JOINT_SHARP.txt are preserved as controls.
The pinching simplification was independently proposed by the Sol auditor
/root/sol_hyperbolic_audit and checked by root and this worker; that is
internal proof provenance, not external validation or mathematical priority.
Independent analytic derivation and scoped receipt are banked at
outputs/research/sol_semiclassical_memory/iid_joint_no_tail/RESULT.txt and
AUDIT_RECEIPT.txt. The refined-Kraus notation repair in the companion
source-localization lemma is applied. External correctness and
priority remain UNKNOWN.

1. EXACT MODEL, FINITE CONVERSE AND MATCHED POLYNOMIAL LAW

Fix known a in (1/3,1/2), b=1-2a, g=3a-1>0, and a known c with public
promise 0<c_min<=c<=c_max<infinity. For sufficiently large n put

  p_n=(a+c/(2sqrt(n)), a-c/(2sqrt(n)), b),
  beta_n=log(p1/p2), qbar=(1+b/a)/2<1, Dq=1-qbar.

The unknown parameter is ALL U in U3. Input and reconstructed target are
(U diag(p_n)U^dag)^tensor n, at worst-case half-trace error <=epsilon.
Maximum conditional quantum branch dimension is Q. Classical alphabets may
be arbitrary in the lower, but are charged separately in an upper. No plane,
axis, purification, entanglement assistance, quantum side input or retained
record is free. n, the spectrum and the error target are public.

There are constants epsilon_c,c_c,c0,c1,n0>0 depending only on a,c_min,c_max
such that for all n>=n0 every such archive obeys BOTH finite lower bounds

  Q>=c_c min{epsilon^(-2),n^2}, 0<epsilon<=epsilon_c;     (1.0)

  Q>=c1 min{epsilon^(-3)/sqrt(n),n^(5/2)},
                            0<epsilon<=c0/sqrt(n).

the experiment on a constant-probability band. Output transitions remain
arbitrary. Actual full and right-U2 mixed source tests control both energies;
single-sector coherent symbols and true discrete flag heat give the rank law.
